sourceTitle: Constance Sherwood: An Autobiography of the Sixteenth Century
description: "Constance Sherwood: An Autobiography of the Sixteenth Century" by Lady Georgiana Fullerton is a historical account narrated in a semi-autobiographical style, likely written in the mid-19th century. It chronicles the life experiences and reflections of its titular character, Constance Sherwood, against the backdrop of the tumultuous 16th century in England.
